title: fraxinus americana subvar. aucubifolia
intro: Fraxinus americana subvar. aucubifolia, commonly known as Red Ash or Green Ash, is a deciduous tree native to North America, characterized by its compound leaves and green bark. The health benefits of Red Ash include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Red Ash include its ability to relax muscles, reduce anxiety, and improve sleep quality, which may be attributed to its sedative and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of Red Ash include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
